blocks.body:
# TacMap — Feature Listing

> Prefer the **[TacMap Field Guide](#/tacmap)** for explanations. This page remains as a compact Tools checklist.

> Full explanations for every feature: **[TacMap complete guide](#/tacmap)**.

## Quick visual

![TacMap feature map](/media/diagrams/tacmap-tools.svg)

Use this map to orient Tools vs Navigation vs graphics vs sensors before reading the feature list.

User-facing features exposed by **TacMap** (`TacticalMapV2Activity`). Source of truth for the Tools palette is `showToolsMenu()` in `TacticalMapV2Activity.kt`.

Open **Tools** on the map to reach this list. Subtitle in-app: *Tracks, plots, navigation, overlays, share, and settings.* Each section title has a one-line description under it. A search box at the top matches the tool name, that description, the section, and common words such as settings, photo, or compass. Clear the box to see the full list again.

**Overlays** is the one place for map layers. The same list opens from Tools, the layers shortcut, and the navigation drawer.

---

## Tools menu

### Tracks

Record where you moved.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Create Track | Start a GPS log, or draw the track by hand |
| Breadcrumbs | Leave a point on the map each time you move (ON/OFF) |

### Plots

Drawings and symbols you place.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Draw Graphics | Point, line, area, or a freehand sketch |
| Control Measures | NATO points, units, and control measures. See `CONTROL_MEASURES.md` |

### Reports

Spot reports, photos, and troops.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| SPOTREP | Place a report with photos and a progress log |
| Photo Mode | Pin a photo at the current GPS location |
| Troop Tracking | Live friendly positions. Coming soon |

### Navigate

Compass, road route, and a grid to open.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Compass Mode | Walk to a point with the FastLock compass |
| Compass Bearing (Resection) | Resect from landmarks, then follow a course |
| Get Directions | Road route from one place to another |
| Go To Grid | Open the map at a latitude, longitude, or grid |

### Measure

Distance, visibility, and height.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Measure & Terrain | Distance, line of sight, or clearance above ground |

**Path clearance** (under Measure & Terrain): 3D arc over the highest ground between two taps, with projectile animation. Formulas and animation timing are in `PATH_CLEARANCE.md`.

**Compass Bearing / Navigate-To:** destination bearing, back bearing (resection), and live vs fixed course behaviour are in `COMPASS_BEARING_NAVIGATION.md`.

### Map Look

Basemap and overlays.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Basemap Style | Satellite, streets, topographic, or OSM. This is the picture under the layers. |
| Overlays | Your own layers. See below. JUPEM maps are not in this list. |

### JUPEM Files

Official maps that use the JUPEM encrypted file, plus the classic Navigation map. Separate from Overlays.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Download Or Decrypt | JUPEM TOPO or OSM file, including a ZIP on the SD card |
| Activate Map | Employ a decrypted TOPO or OSM map, or stand it down |
| Legacy Nav Map | Open the classic Navigation map |

#### Overlays

Opened from **Tools → Overlays**, the layers shortcut, or **Navigation features → Overlays**. Search matches the layer name and its description.

| Group | Feature | Detail |
|-------|---------|--------|
| On The Map | Offline Overlays | Show or hide downloaded tiles, GeoPDF, and MBTiles |
| On The Map | Grid Lines | UTM or MGRS lines drawn on the map |
| On The Map | Imported Graphics | Show, hide, rename, or delete a shared graphics layer |
| On The Map | Map Library | Drawings, tracks, photos, and offline maps you kept |
| Import | Import Battle Graphics | Open a passphrase-locked graphics file |
| Your Map Packages | Download Map Area | Save the ground in view for offline use |
| Your Map Packages | Import GeoPDF Or GeoTIFF | Add a map sheet you supply |
| Your Map Packages | Import MBTiles Or TPK | Add an offline tile pack you supply |

### Share

Send graphics or a picture of the map.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Share Battle Graphics | Send or open a passphrase-locked graphics file (`.shua`). See `BATTLE_GRAPHICS_SHARE.md` |
| Share Overlay Screenshot | Send a picture of the map as it looks now |

### Set Values

Formats and the numbers on screen.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Coordinate Format | Choose which grids show when you tap a point |
| Map Screen HUD | Crosshair, own position, and radial-menu copy values |

### This Device

Tracking, lock, screen, and save.

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| Location Tracking | Background location for tracks and sharing (ON/OFF) |
| Kiosk Mode | Lock this device so it stays in TacNav |
| Hide Or Show Map UI | Hide the buttons for a clearer map |
| Save Changes | Store drawings and layers on this device |
| More | Communications, health, and other ops tools |

---

## More (overflow)

Opened from **Tools → More**. In-app subtitle: *Ops actions not on the main Tools list.*

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| COMM | Platoon net · brevity codes · local demo |
| Share My Grid / Coordinate | Share inspected coordinate text |
| Personnel / COP / tasks | Ops / situational awareness menu |
| Device Health | Map data, location sharing, GNSS summary |
| Capability Status | Capability registry availability dialog |

---

## Navigation features drawer

Secondary list (`showNavDrawerFeaturesMenu()`). Grouped the same way as Tools, with the same search box. Your own layers open from **Overlays**. JUPEM download, decrypt, and on/off are under **JUPEM files**.

| Group | Feature | Detail |
|-------|---------|--------|
| Navigate | Go To Grid | Open the map at a latitude, longitude, or grid |
| Navigate | Compass Bearing (Resection) | Resect from landmarks, then follow a course |
| Navigate | Compass / Navigate To | Walk to a point with the FastLock compass |
| Navigate | Get Directions | Road route from one place to another |
| Navigate | Range & Bearing | Distance and bearing between two points |
| Map Look | Basemap Style | Satellite, streets, topographic, or OSM |
| Map Look | Overlays | The same overlay list as Tools |
| JUPEM Files | Download Or Decrypt | JUPEM TOPO or OSM file, including a ZIP on the SD card |
| JUPEM Files | Activate Map | Employ a decrypted TOPO or OSM map, or stand it down |
| JUPEM Files | Legacy Nav Map | Open the classic Navigation map |
| Set Values | Coordinate Format | Choose which grids show when you tap a point |
| Ops | Ops / Capabilities | COP, personnel, tasks, and status |

**Hidden (commented in code):** HERE WeGo external turn-by-turn navigation.
